name: Fluorite
color: Banded purple, green, blue and clear
description: The rainbow study stone. Fluorite is traditionally worn to clear mental clutter, hold concentration and make learning feel lighter.
mineral: Fluorite is calcium fluoride that grows in glassy cubes. Traces of different elements colour each band, so one bead can carry purple, green, blue and clear layers side by side.
foundIn: China, Mexico, South Africa and England
wornFor: A fluorite bracelet is traditionally worn for focus, clear thinking and easier learning, which is why it is a favourite of students and anyone who works at a screen all day. It belongs to the third eye and heart chakras and is linked with Capricorn and Pisces. The banded colours make every bead different, so no two rainbow fluorite bracelets match. It is a soft stone, so keep it away from water and long sun.
wristWhy: Wear fluorite on the left wrist. Stones for the mind are traditionally worn on the receiving side, where they are said to steady attention rather than send it out.
waterNote: Fluorite is soft (4 on the Mohs scale) and can dull or scratch in water, so cleanse it with smoke, selenite or moonlight instead.
